# GitHub Copilot Premium Configuration

This repository has been configured to enable GitHub Copilot premium features with a budget limit.

## Configuration Files

### .github/copilot.json
This file enables GitHub Copilot premium features at the repository level with the following settings:
- **Premium Enabled**: Yes
- **Budget Limit**: 20

### .vscode/settings.json
This file configures VS Code workspace settings to use GitHub Copilot advanced/premium features:
- **Premium Mode**: Enabled
- **Budget Limit**: 20

## What This Enables

With premium features enabled and a budget limit of 20, you get:
- Access to advanced AI models
- Enhanced code suggestions
- Better context understanding
- Increased request limits within the budget

## Usage

Once these configuration files are in place, GitHub Copilot will automatically use premium features when available, respecting the configured budget limit of 20 requests.

No additional setup is required - the settings will apply automatically when you work in this repository with GitHub Copilot enabled in your editor.
